Rooms.Name: The Grand Gate of Thalos
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the archway of a gigantic stone archway. The two steel gates
have been forced open and have rusted in place. A hollow gust of wind blows by
you into the deserted, and seemingly destroyed, city.

Exits.Description: The desert sands stretch on for miles and miles.

You see devastation everywhere. Houses lie in ruin and skeletons litter the
streets. You see strange beasts stalking the shadows.

Rooms.Name: Main Street
Rooms.Description:
This was once a magnificent street, but now is in total ruin. The streets
are barren and windswept and the silence is unending. To the south you see a
ruined cottage while north leads into a dark back alley. Howls and screams echo
through the deserted city.

Exits.Description: It's a dark alley.
The entrance to the city lies this way.
A ruined shack lies to the south.
Main Street lies this way.

Rooms.Name: Main Street
Rooms.Description:
This was once a magnificent street, but now is in total ruin. The streets
are barren and windswept and the silence is unending. On one side is a
collapsed house while on the other is the entrance to a large ruined mansion.
Eerie sounds echo within the mansion. Near the center of town you see a large
domed building, relatively intact.

Exits.Description: The remnants of a store lie this way.
It looks like what used to be the main building in the city.
A withered garden path lies this way.

Rooms.Name: A garden path
Rooms.Description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of the
city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare. Vines and
ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves around your feet.
A sudden volley of howls pierces the air.

Exits.Description: The garden path continues around the building.
This is the main street leading to the city's entrance
The garden path continues around the building.

Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as well as
a few holes in the ceiling.

Rooms.Name: A garden path
Rooms.Description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of the
city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare. Vines and
ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves around your feet.

Exits.Description: A side street leads of to the northern half of the city.
The garden path continues around the building.

Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as well as
a few holes in the ceiling.
The garden path continues around the building.

Rooms.Name: A garden path
Rooms.Description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of the
city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare. Vines and
ivy creep up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves around your feet.

Exits.Description: The garden path continues around the building.

Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as well as
a few cracks in the ceiling.
The garden path continues around the building.
What looks like a market place lies this way.

Rooms.Name: A garden path
Rooms.Description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of the
city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare. Vines and
ivy creep up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves around your feet.

Exits.Description:
Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as well as
a few cracks in the ceiling.
The garden path continues around the building.
A small side street leads to the southern half of the city.
The garden path continues around the building.

Rooms.Name: The market place
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of a large square lined on each side with baskets,
carts, and stands of all shapes and sizes. Abandoned, these little shops still
contain some of their goods once sold to a demanding public.

Exits.Description:
A small table has been toppled over, spilling fine jewelry and gems onto the
ground.
A small garden path encircles a large domed temple in the center of the city.
Rotted remains of fruits and vegetables lie strewn about.
The market place continues.

Rooms.Name: The market place
Rooms.Description:
You stand at the end of the market square. Stands and carts line each side,
filled with remnants of fine foods and exquisite goods. A small hole in the
western wall of the city leads back out into the desert.

Exits.Description: Tattered carpets and ruined bales of silk sit idly by a run down stand.
The center of the market lies this way.

>From the massive stench, this must have been a meat and poultry stand. It lies
totally bare.

Rooms.Name: A side street
Rooms.Description:
This small side street leads east and west into back alleys while to the
south you see the temple. The incessant howling tears at your mind.

Rooms.Name: A side street
Rooms.Description:
You are in the common section of the city. Ruined buildings made of clay and
stone is all the view has to offer. Most of these homes are nothing but piles
of rubble, but some look almost safe enough to venture into. The street
continues north and south and buildings line the street.

Exits.Description: A small doorway leads into a partially collapsed house.
A small clay dwelling sits here.

Rooms.Name: A side street
Rooms.Description:
This small side street leads away from the garden path to the south. Around
you stand large piles or rubble where the houses of commoners used to be. A
lone howl makes you worry greatly about your safety here.

Exits.Description: An unusually tall dwelling stands looming over you.
A garden path circles around the temple.
Here lies a small stone house with a thatched roof.

Rooms.Name: A side street
Rooms.Description:
This small side street leads south away from the temple into the business
section of town. The destruction that leveled this city was not biased; these
important looking buildings have been almost totally destroyed. There is a hole
in the wall of a very large structure to the east.

Exits.Description: A small garden path encircles the temple.
This possibly could be the city hall.
Inside the building you see long pieces of metal, an oven, and some anvils.

Rooms.Name: A side street
Rooms.Description:
This small side street is lined with the remains of once great buildings. To
the north is a dark, foreboding structure while to the south lies the entrance
to a small tavern. The street continues north and south.

Exits.Description:
>From the looks of it, this was once a two story abode. The entire second floor
has collapsed leaving a very little part of the bar still free from debris.

This seems to be the only guild house in the entire city. It's dark nature
makes you wonder about its' origins.

Rooms.Name: A side street
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long street leading to the center of the city. A
long dark alley runs east and west.

Rooms.Name: Under a ruined watchtower
Rooms.Description:
You stand at the base of a tall watchtower built to protect the city from
invaders. From the looks of things, it did not do a good job.

Rooms.Name: A back alley
Rooms.Description:
This alley leads to the rear of what used to be a meat stand. You wince at
the stench. South is one of the city watchtowers.

Exits.Description: You see the back-side of the market place meat stand.
A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.

Rooms.Name: The meat stand
Rooms.Description:
A large stand has been set up here with metal hooks and wooden racks in the
background. Hanging on the hooks are very small scraps of meat and other game.
This stand is relatively empty, and a sudden burst of howling and screaming
makes you realize why this is so.

Exits.Description: The market place lies this way.
This is a cart full of rotted vegetables and fruits.

Rooms.Name: A back alley
Rooms.Description:
A narrow alley leads east to a wider street and west to one of the city
watchtowers.

Exits.Description: A small side street greets you.
A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.

Rooms.Name: The guild house
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in what once was this city's ONLY guild house. Tables and
chairs have been smashed and broken weapons lie strewn about the floor as if
some massive battle had taken place here. Draped along the back wall is a
tattered, jet-black banner with the symbol of the Darkside set upon it.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the building.

Rooms.Name: The produce stand
Rooms.Description:
A large cart sits here carrying rotted fruit and vegetables. Flies swarm all
about what seems to be the last remaining bits of food left in the city.

Exits.Description: The market place is deserted.
A strong stench emanates from the meat stand next to you.

Rooms.Name: The smithy
Rooms.Description:
In here you find tools and anvils used to make various weapons and items.
The walls have been stripped clean and only a few incomplete pieces of armor
and weaponry are left.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the building.

Rooms.Name: The tapestry stand
Rooms.Description:
Tattered and torn tapestries and rugs lie heaped in piles. Fancy robes and
various articles of clothing are now just rags. You stare at the strange piles
for a long time until a piercing howl makes you think these might be beds.

Exits.Description: A fine jewelry stand lies in ruin next to you.
The market place is deserted.

Rooms.Name: A back alley
Rooms.Description:
A narrow alley leads north to one of the city watchtowers while to the south
there lies a market stand full of torn clothes and rugs.

Exits.Description: A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.

Rooms.Name: Under the watchtower
Rooms.Description:
You stand under one of the city watchtowers built to protect the city from
invaders. Obviously, it failed.

Exits.Description: Above you looms a tall watchtower.

Rooms.Name: The jewelry stand
Rooms.Description:
A table has been tipped over, spilling fine jewelry and gems across the
market place. Most of these trinkets are battered and tarnished and few would
have any value anymore.

Exits.Description: The market place is deserted.
Next to you is a stand full of ruined clothes and rugs.

Rooms.Name: A ruined clay dwelling
Rooms.Description:
This was once a very plain house with nothing more than a few chairs and a
bed. A cold fireplace suggests that the city has been abandoned for quite a
while. Almost nothing remains of this humble abode.

Exits.Description: Outside is a small side street.

Rooms.Name: A collapsed stone dwelling
Rooms.Description:
This small house has completely collapsed upon itself leaving piles of
debris here and there. A few rafters still stand with thatched straw hanging
down and a hot wind gusts through the hollow dwelling.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the house.

Rooms.Name: A back alley
Rooms.Description:
A narrow alley leads east to one of the city watchtowers and west to a small
side street.

Rooms.Name: An abandoned shop
Rooms.Description:
From the outside this place looks like an ordinary pile of rubble, but
inside these cramped quarters you discover what used to be a shop filled with
armor, weapons, and various other goods. A small sign flutters in the wind.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the shop.

Rooms.Name: The Tavern of the Sun
Rooms.Description:
A glorious place in it's prime, this tavern now lies in ruin; tables and
chairs are broken scattered, bottles and glasses shattered, and a small
performance stage crushed. Musical instruments and personal belongings lie
under the rubble, but the people they once belonged to are not with them.
Looking up you see that the entire second floor and roof has fallen in, leaving
a gaping hole above.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the tavern.

Rooms.Name: South wing of the city hall
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a large room attached to this end of the hallway which leads
back north to the reception area. Pedestals and columns have fallen and most of
the valuable items have been taken, leaving worthless debris. A few chairs have
survived, as well as a large curved desk. To the east is a vine-covered archway
leading out into a private courtyard.

Exits.Description: The long hallway leads back to the main reception area of the city hall.

Rooms.Name: The city hall
Rooms.Description:
This is the main reception area of Thalos' city hall. The walls have been
charred and scored massively and debris is spread from wall to wall. A large
gaping hole in the west wall allows you to see out to one of the city's side
streets. Obviously no one will be seeing you through today. Hallways lead south
and east.

Exits.Description: Main street runs past the city hall.
A hallway leads to the east wing of the city hall.
A hallway leads to the south wing of the city hall.

Rooms.Name: East wing of the city hall
Rooms.Description:
Here lies the remnants of a fancy office, possibly the mayor's. A few
withered plants and broken pieces of furniture make this place anything but
fancy, though. The only thing remaining intact here is a large glass cabinet. A
long hallway leads west back to the reception area and an ivy-covered archway
leads south into a private courtyard.

Rooms.Name: The private gardens and courtyard of Thalos
Rooms.Description:
What a shame that this mass destruction also touched this once beautiful
place. The temple's garden path has nothing on this garden. Flowers and trees
have been smashed into the ground and lawn benches thrown through walls. A
large marble fountain in the center of the courtyard still stands, though,
defying any attempts to destroy its beauty. Above stands the remnants of one of
the watchtowers. Archways north and west lead back into the city hall.

Rooms.Name: A small guard house
Rooms.Description:
This was once the barracks for Thalos' Cityguards. Now just an empty shell,
this small shack still stands guarding the entrance both to the city and to the
city hall.

Exits.Description: Main street runs by this building.

Rooms.Name: A collapsed home
Rooms.Description:
All that's left of this house is a few scattered piles of rubble and a very
large blast crater. Obviously someone or something important was once housed
here. A shrieking howl chills your blood.

Exits.Description: Main street runs past this ruined home.

Rooms.Name: A tall dwelling
Rooms.Description:
This seems to be the tallest structure remaining in the city. At one time
this could have been an inn of some sort, but now it's just a mess. The back
wall as been completely knocked down revealing an entrance into another
building through yet another collapsed wall. Between the two buildings are a
few blast craters and boulders. An old set of wooden steps leads up to a
creaking second floor.

Exits.Description: A small side street winds past the dwelling.

The stairs and even the entire second floor itself looks very unsafe for
travel. Gusts of wind make them creak and shudder.

Rooms.Name: A small shack
Rooms.Description:
This cramped dwelling could not have housed more than one person. Now with
the back wall missing, it could hold many more. Looking around you find broken
shelves and workbenches with various vials and pouches spilling contents all
across the floor. This was possibly the magic shop of the city. The doorway to
the east is blocked, making the only exit back west.

Rooms.Name: A back alley
Rooms.Description:
A narrow back alley goes south to main street and north towards a
watchtower. A mass of howls catches you of guard.

Exits.Description: Main street runs past here.

Rooms.Name: A back alley
Rooms.Description:
A narrow back alley leads north to one of the city watchtowers and south
towards main street. To the west is a doorway to a small house blocked by
debris.

Exits.Description: A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.

Rooms.Name: Under a watchtower
Rooms.Description:
You stand under a tall watchtower. Narrow back alleys lead west and south
and a very weak looking ladder leads up into the tower. Above you, you hear the
screams of tens of starving lamias! Beware!

Exits.Description:
Winds howl high above your head in the tower above. You hear the screams of
tens of howling lamias above you!

Rooms.Name: A bath house
Rooms.Description:
This was once the bath house for the commoners of the city. Hot steamy water
still wells up from a hole in the floor. Obviously there is a hot spring
located under the city (making the decision to put a city here seem much more
reasonable). Closer inspection of the water yields a dead body floating around
in it, skin melted away from months of floating in there. The west wall has
collapsed revealing another collapsed house.

Exits.Description: The wall has collapsed on the adjoining house, creating a new opening in it.

Rooms.Name: A back alley
Rooms.Description:
A narrow back alley leads west to a small side street and east to one of the
city watchtowers. Great amounts of steam issue forth from the building to the
south.

Exits.Description: A watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.
A side street runs by here.

Rooms.Name: An upright house
Rooms.Description:
This home is practically the only one around that is still standing. Except
for the massive hole in the east wall, everything else looks intact, including
the windows. Great amounts of steam issue forth from the hole in the east wall.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the house.

Rooms.Name: On the second floor
Rooms.Description:
The minute you step off onto this floor you realize it was a mistake. The
old rotted floorboards suddenly give way and you fall down, impaling yourself
on jagged boards below.

Rooms.Name: The north-west watchtower
Rooms.Description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent from
here and you can see all the way to the western mountains. No wonder this place
stood for so long.

Exits.Description: The city lies below.

Rooms.Name: The south-west watchtower
Rooms.Description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent from
here and you can see all the way to the western mountains. To the south the
desert stretches to the horizon. No wonder this place stood for so long.

Exits.Description: The city lies below.

Rooms.Name: The north-east watchtower
Rooms.Description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent from
here and you can see a great floating pyramid to the north-east. Desert sand
stretches to the horizon. No wonder this place stood for so long. The ladder
leading down seems rotted in some places!

Exits.Description: The city lies below.... far, far below.

Rooms.Name: Under a watchtower
Rooms.Description:
As you descend the ladder, the rotted rungs break, sending you quickly to
your demise far below on the city street. Splat.

Rooms.Name: The Temple of Thalos
Rooms.Description:
You stand within one of the most holy places in the realm. This stunning
domed temple once housed the city's worshipers en masse. Unfortunately, it
succumbed to the destruction brought on this city. Long benches lie toppled and
the altar desecrated. Large chunks of stone have fallen from the walls and
roof, sending sunlight streaming in on you. A few books lie about, conveying to
you a holy message in a strange tongue. Wind gusts through the four archways
and howls and screams can be heard from all parts of the city.

Exits.Description: A side street leads to the northern half of the city.
Main street leads out to the main gate of the city.
A side street leads to the southern part of the city.
The market place lies this way.

Mobs.Name: beholder
Mobs.LongDescription: You meet a beholder's deadly gaze!
Mobs.Description:
It has a large central eye that projects an anti-magic ray and ten
eyestalks atop the round body which can do anything from charm you
to disintegrate you.  Beholders are not known for their personality.

Mobs.Name: lamia beast
Mobs.LongDescription: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
Mobs.Description:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the 
lower body of a four-legged beast.  She licks her lips as she looks 
at you greedily.

Mobs.Name: mimic chest
Mobs.LongDescription: A strong chest lies in one corner of the room.
Mobs.Description:
A strong, wooden chest bound with iron straps and a heavy pad-lock on 
the front.

Mobs.Name: mimic boulder
Mobs.LongDescription: Two skeletons lie crushed under a large boulder.

Mobs.Name: mimic floor
Mobs.LongDescription: The stone floor of this house has been ripped apart.

Mobs.Name: mimic pottery
Mobs.LongDescription: Some broken shards of pottery lie strewn about the floor.

Mobs.Name: mimic planks
Mobs.LongDescription: A few wooden planks lie stacked on a low shelf.

Mobs.Name: lizard horned
Mobs.LongDescription: A small horned lizard flicks his tongue and slithers away.
Mobs.Description: A cute little lizard -- that is, if you like reptiles!

Mobs.Name: golem stone
Mobs.LongDescription: In the corner you see a large, stone golem faithfully standing watch.
Mobs.Description:
It is a big chunk of rock that has been magically formed into a giant 
stone creature.  He stands here still guarding the city.

Mobs.Name: lamia beast
Mobs.LongDescription: A strange lamia stares at you hungrily.
Mobs.Description:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the 
lower body of a four-legged beast.  She licks her lips as she looks 
at you greedily.

Objects.Name: ringmail vest
Objects.Description: A vest made of iron rings lies heaped on the floor.

Objects.Name: helm iron
Objects.Description: An iron helm has been left on the ground.

Objects.Name: gauntlets iron
Objects.Description: A pair of iron gauntlets rests heavily on the ground.

Objects.Name: sleeves iron
Objects.Description: A set of iron sleeves lies on the ground.

Objects.Name: boots iron
Objects.Description: A pair of iron boots has been left here.

Objects.Name: greaves iron
Objects.Description: A set of iron greaves lie here unattended.

Objects.Name: girth iron
Objects.Description: A small iron girth lies at your feet.

Objects.Name: breast plate iron
Objects.Description: A battered iron breast plate lies here.

Objects.Name: shield iron
Objects.Description: A small, but sturdy, iron shield has been left here.

Objects.Name: potion black
Objects.Description: A jet black potion sits upright waiting to be taken.

Objects.Name: potion orange
Objects.Description: A small orange potion lies here.

Objects.Name: staff serpentine
Objects.Description: A green serpentine staff has been left here.

Objects.Name: ball quartz
Objects.Description: A smooth quartz ball lies here gleaming.

Objects.Name: scroll tattered
Objects.Description: A worn and tattered scroll has been left here.

Objects.Name: scroll bound
Objects.Description: A bound scroll of detection lies at your feet.

Objects.Name: flute silver
Objects.Description: A brilliant silver flute glimmers from beneath a rock.

Objects.Name: talisman demon
Objects.Description: A demon-faced talisman glares at you angrily.

Objects.Name: venison chunk
Objects.Description: A large chunk of venison sits here, ready to be eaten.

Objects.Name: fountain cracked
Objects.ActionDescription: A pool of blood lies in the bottom of the fountain.

Objects.Name: two-handed two sword
Objects.Description: A nice two-handed sword hangs on a hook in the wall.

Objects.Name: robe black silk
Objects.Description: A black silk robe lies heaped in one corner.

Objects.Name: cloak green
Objects.Description: A beautiful dark green cloak has been dropped here by someone.

Objects.Name: seal ebony
Objects.Description: A small, engraved ebony seal is here.

Objects.Name: seal ivory
Objects.Description: A small, engraved ivory seal lies here.

Objects.Name: arm rotted
Objects.Description: A half-rotted arm floats lazily past your feet.

Objects.Name: stone pale blue
Objects.Description: A pale blue stone sits here.

Objects.Name: stone scarlet blue
Objects.Description: A pretty scarlet and blue stone has been dropped here.

Objects.Name: stone blue incandescent
Objects.Description: A small incandescent blue stone lies here.

Objects.Name: stone red deep
Objects.Description: Someone has left a deep red stone here.

Objects.Name: stone pink
Objects.Description: A tiny pink stone lies at your feet.

Objects.Name: stone pearly white
Objects.Description: A lovely, pearly white stone has been carelessly left here.

Objects.Name: stone lavender pale
Objects.Description: A beautiful pale lavender stone lies here.

Objects.Name: stone lavender green
Objects.Description: A stunning lavender and green stone rests on the ground.

Objects.Name: stone rose dusty
Objects.Description: A stone is here, sort of a dusty rose color and very pretty.

Objects.Name: stone grey dull
Objects.Description: You can barely make out a dull grey stone on the ground.

Objects.Name: stone purple vibrant
Objects.Description: A stunningly vibrant purple stone attracts your attention.

Objects.Name: stone pink green
Objects.Description: A bright pink and green stone has been left here.

Objects.Name: stone green pale
Objects.Description: A pale green stone lies here collecting dust.

Objects.Name: stone clear
Objects.Description: An odd clear stone lies at your feet.

Objects.Name: stone irridescent
Objects.Description: A large irridescent stone has been left here.

Objects.Name: mandolin
Objects.Description: A mandolin lies against the wall.

Objects.Name: harp golden
Objects.Description: A battered golden harp has been tipped over.

Objects.Name: wristguard serpentine metal coil thalosobj
Objects.Description: Pitted, scarred metal lies here in a coil.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A thick coil of metal, stained with verdigris and hammered into a
remarkable likeness of a snake, lies in your hands. The eyes and fangs
are made of quartz, and when light plays off them, you'd swear the
little snake could come alive and sink its fangs into the flesh of your
palm......
